scopeDecisions.warning: Use the structured NPC preparation of 750 ms. Preserve the committed world point and recheck range, visibility and ground at release.
scopeDecisions.separateClocks: Attempt the configured entry statuses once per eligible target per instance. Periodic area damage starts after one interval and includes the scheduled expiry pulse.
scopeDecisions.pulseDamage: Read current target maximum HP, then share the reduction, shield and HP chain used by the NPC moving area. The fire-pool sample sets unavoidable contact.
scopeDecisions.burnDeadline: Ordinary DOT is end-exclusive. A 3000 ms application with 1000 ms intervals schedules two status ticks.
scopeDecisions.sourceLoss: The configured area can keep pulsing under the released NPC identity. Entry burn follows ordinary source lifetime and status removal.
scopeDecisions.history: Keep one pulse contact-history row per member identity while separately counting successful pulses.
scopeDecisions.scratch: Use one shared batch scratch directory and the project Cargo cache.

openInR3.4: Fixed-point instant strikes, other world effects and production geometry integration
